main.description: Report an account's access status for a named beta feature: whether it has been granted (via a trusted place.stream.beta.invite, or because this node isn't beta-gating the feature), has an outstanding place.stream.beta.request, or neither. Defaults to the authenticated caller when `did` is omitted.

did.description: Account to check. Defaults to the authenticated caller's DID when omitted.

feature.description: Identifier of the beta feature to check (e.g. "vod").

did.description: The account this status applies to.

feature.description: The feature this status applies to (echoes the request).

status.description: granted: the account may use the feature. requested: no grant yet, but an access request is on file. none: no grant and no request.

errors.description: No did supplied and the request was not authenticated, so there is no account to check.
errors.name: DidRequired
